rows.label: Dark Split-Sword research
rows.note: 10,000 cr, 1 Tellurium, 800 Alloy Plate, 62 Rubedo, 20 Mutagen Sample; 2 days

conditions: Research costs are Ghost-tier; resources scale x3/x10/x30/x100 with clan size.
In an established clan it is almost certainly done already.
The Dual Skana is its own Mastery item and the recipe consumes it; level it to 30 first.

groups.activity: Lvl 30-50 bounty when its reward is Mutagen
conditions: The bounty only pays Mutagen Mass when its rotating reward is Mutagen rather than Detonite or Fieldron.
bonuses: Grab Infested Invasions that pay Mutagen Mass on sight; they go fast.

disclosures.title: crafting it instead
disclosures.body: The Bio Lab Mutagen Mass research takes 72 hours (5,000 cr, 5 Mutagen Sample, 150 Circuits, 500 Nano Spores, 100 Plastids). Each Mass then costs a 15,000 cr blueprint plus 15,000 cr, 10 Mutagen Sample, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage and 250 Plastids, 12 hours. Ten Masses is 100 Samples; players near-unanimously farm them built.

bonuses: Polymer Bundle, Ferrite, Alloy Plate and Rubedo are common; top them up along the way.

rows.note: 20,000 cr, 1 Dual Skana, 1 Forma, 1,200 Rubedo, 10 Mutagen Mass

conditions: It doesn't count as melee for Sorties or some Nightwave melee-only acts.
The form is fixed by the stance slotted in the Arsenal; it can't switch mid-mission.

disclosures.title: fissure trick
disclosures.body: The relic reactant buff never lands on it, so with it as the only weapon equipped the buff always goes to the Warframe for 2x ability Strength and Range.
